verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the merging-accounts doc, which names "Poke's Memory" as a persistent account-level asset alongside Recipes and Integrations. That shows a first-party memory feature exists, but nothing documents what it stores or how it is applied in later chats. Missing for 10: documentation of what Memory captures from prior chats, evidence it is recalled and applied in new conversations, user controls to view or edit memory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: This keeps Poke's Memory, Recipes, and Integrations from the selected account
